scope: Survey unverified-domain delivery failure must not report success
behavior: Ticket and project invitation service rejects an unverified-domain transport failure instead of returning a successful survey invitation.
Failed delivery removes the invitation and publishes no sent/reminder events.
A subsequent successful retry creates one invitation with a usable token and emits SURVEY_SENT without a false reminder.
limits: Real PostgreSQL persistence and email template rendering are exercised; transport returns synthetic provider errors.
Native candidate CI and actual provider delivery are not established by this local run.
